leadText:
Oliver (Japanese: セイヤ Seiya) is a character of the day who appeared in Dreams Are Made of These!. He is from Goldenrod City.

During the Pokémon Orienteering competition, Oliver met and challenged him to a Normal Class World Coronation Series . He sent out his against Ash's Pikachu, and despite having the type advantage, Meganium lost after a tough battle. Afterwards, he congratulated Ash and promised he would be victorious in the next battle.

==Trivia==
In the Japanese version, Seiya and Soshinium are named after and portrayed by Seiya and Soshina, who together form the Japanese comedy duo .
Shimofuri Myojo is based in Osaka. Osaka's Pokémon world counterpart is Goldenrod City, Seiya's hometown.
Similarly, in the English dub, Oliver and Stanium are named after the members of , a comedy duo formed by and .
Oliver's hair has the shape of leaves, a possible reference to his type specialty, in this case, .
